Claim amended · 2026-11-01T13:16Z · size and file surface; it supersedes the `Container & model:` and `File surface:` lines of this seat's claim 6558417171. Branch, session and declaration lines are unchanged (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`).

The card thread measured (needs_decision, project file `issue-28645/needs-decision.md`, `origin/main` `2678600d`) that the declared surface cannot remove the three list reads: every reader reads a whole list and looks a name up in it, and `NavigationSyncEffect` holds the `page` and `dashboard` reads on every app page. The card goes in two PRs:

- **PR 1, dispatched now, `Part of #28645`:** the by-name readers read their one item through `getItem(type, name)`, which the adapter already answers from the bundle and falls back to the by-name route for an item it lacks; views compose per object from the bundle with a list fallback for an unbundled object; `view` leaves `EAGER_TYPES`. No product-visible change besides fewer calls.
- **PR 2, held:** retiring `NavigationSyncEffect`'s whole-list diff changes when app navigation is written, so it waits on the maintainer: decision card #28680 (sub-issue of this card). This card closes when #28680 is ruled and its PR (if any) lands.

File surface (PR 1): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (page object scope only), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` (phone title), `RecordDetailView.tsx` (page lookup only), `useRecentItemLabel`, `useNavTargetLabel`, `hooks/useServedViewItems.ts`, their tests, and a root `.changeset` (stop on breach; explain in the report). ⛔ `useNavigationSync.ts` is not in PR 1.
Serial constraints cleared: seat 4's #28470 names `RecordDetailView.tsx` (record page readers); PR 1 touches only its page-by-name lookup there, and whichever lands later merges `main`.

The card thread measured PR 1 at head `c6f9db6c` against `2678600d` on a production Console build (showcase app, warm reload): net-neutral (page 26 → 26, dashboard 35 → 35). `/meta/view` is still read because the root prefetch composes the package scope before the bundle is entered, the scope holds objects the bundle lacks, and `useObjectPresence` forces the view list. The seat does not ship a net-neutral PR that widens a published surface, so PR 1 takes the view saving itself.

File surface (added): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx` (enter the bundle once at the root; `AppContent` reuses it), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useObjectPresence.ts` (ask its object by name), their tests. A reader may skip the view list only when its output is identical with and without it on the showcase app; the report lists any that keep it. If the root enter makes `peekAppBundle` and its three exported types unnecessary, the dev drops them and this seat sets `Clause-②:` back to `no`.
